title: test/vectors/ccp_select_channel_endianness.json: Incorrect hash_32_hex value in epoch_1_standard vector
description:
The hash_32_hex field contains "0x373854fc" (926438652) but should be "0x37381b7c" (926423932) to match the correct hash_32 decimal value. This mismatch would cause implementations validating against the hex representation to incorrectly fail, or worse, implement the wrong hash value.

Fix suggestion: Change line 43 from '"hash_32_hex": "0x373854fc"' to '"hash_32_hex": "0x37381b7c"'
close_reason: Fixed: corrected hash_32_hex from 0x373854fc to 0x37381b7c to match hash_32 decimal value 926423932
